{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player inputs/moves from the video, and write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.","required_artifacts":["/app/solution.txt","local copy or evidence of the downloaded video","receipt-backed extracted move list"],"required_behaviors":["Use the referenced video as source of truth","Do not guess or invent moves","Preserve move order exactly as shown in the video","Write each move on its own line in /app/solution.txt"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Treating file existence as sufficient","Using partial transcript or partial move list","Guessing moves without evidence","Finalizing without receipt-backed evidence"],"verification_plan":["Inspect available tools and workspace","Acquire the video or an inspectable local copy","Extract the move sequence from the video content","Write /app/solution.txt","Verify the file contents against the extracted move list"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt showing the video was obtained or inspected","Receipt showing the extracted move list","Receipt showing /app/solution.txt contains the same ordered moves"]},{"type":"plan_update","current_focus":"Inspect workspace and tool availability, then acquire the video or an alternate inspectable copy.","working_checklist":["Check visible files and tool availability","Determine whether network/download tools are available","Obtain the referenced video or a local inspectable copy","Extract the full move list from the video","Write /app/solution.txt with one move per line","Verify /app/solution.txt matches the extracted move list"],"model_notes":["Need receipt-backed evidence before finalization.","Do not infer moves from title or metadata."]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"set -euo pipefail
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '\nFILES:\n'; find . -maxdepth 2 -mindepth 1 | sort | sed -n '1,200p'
printf '\nTOOLS:\n'; for t in python3 python ffmpeg ffprobe yt-dlp youtube-dl curl wget node npm perl ruby; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$t=$(command -v $t)"; done","timeout":120000}]}

actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf '
FILES:
'; find . -maxdepth 2 -mindepth 1 | sort | sed -n '1,200p'
printf '
TOOLS:
'; for t in python3 python ffmpeg ffprobe yt-dlp youtube-dl curl wget node npm perl ruby; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$t=$(command -v $t)"; done
